text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Huff, puff...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: ...I lost!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Maaan, I still couldn't show what I'm
really made
of!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
I thought I gave it everything I had, so
what the
heck?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Well, I guess that's the Classic Triple
Crown tour
for you... Everyone sure was
fierce...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
But I'm still just getting started! I may
have lost
my chance at the Triple Crown,
but the tour's not
over yet.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
And now that I've seen Bourbon run up
close, I've
got a decent feel for how she
runs.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
So...
it'll be fine! I still have a chance to
win the
Japanese Derby!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Meanwhile, not so far away...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Hey, is Bourbon... okay?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Failure to secure victory in the Satsuki
Sho has rendered the Triple Crown
unattainable. The one
and only dream
that I shared with Father is...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Oxygen levels declining below normal
levels.
Cause unknown. Executing
emergency deep
breathing.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Inhale... Exhale... Inhale... Exhale...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...Phew. The next race is the Japanese
Derby.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Even if I'm defeated, I cannot stop
running.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mihono Bourbon quickly leaves the
racecourse.
Behind her, a small figure
runs up, as if to chase
after her.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Bourbon!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...No, this isn't the time to worry.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure that Bourbon and everyone else
will be
much stronger next race!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I have so, so, sooo much work to do
before the
Japanese Derby!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I need to get stronger... Much, much
stronger!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Rice... And Bourbon... They sure looked

determined, huh?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Now that I think about it...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Rice was awesome today too in her own
way!
Like, bam! Wowza!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
I think she's going to go even harder in
the
Japanese Derby and the Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
I really can't afford to let up.
So it's time
to put in
the work!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
First things first! Let's go eat some
ramen!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Because I'm starving!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Afterwards, we go inside the first ramen
shop we
come across and get our slurp
on.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Excuse me! More noodles, please!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We recharge and shift our focus to the
upcoming
Japanese Derby!
